config.deadeye.title: Dead Eye Configuration
config.deadeye.deadeyeTickRate.name: Dead Eye Tick Rate
config.deadeye.deadeyeTickRate.desc: Sets the tick rate (game speed) while Dead Eye is activated.
config.deadeye.forceTickRate.name: Change Dead Eye Game Speed in Multiplayer
config.deadeye.forceTickRate.desc: Force tick rate to be applied while there are multiple players.
config.deadeye.bowPullCompensation.name: Bow Pull Speed Compensation
config.deadeye.bowPullCompensation.desc: Compensates bows/crossbows pull speed while Dead Eye is activated.
config.deadeye.pitchShift.name: Sound Pitch Shift
config.deadeye.pitchShift.desc: Shifts pitches of all sounds to the Dead Eye tick rate. (game speed)
config.deadeye.targetMarkSize.name: Target Mark Size
config.deadeye.targetMarkSize.desc: Size of the target marks in Dead Eye
